newsitem.title: USA: UCAR to contest class action suit.
newsitem.headline: UCAR to contest class action suit.

text.p: UCAR International Inc said Monday it was served with a complaint in a class action suit on behalf of steelmakers that consume graphite electrodes.
The company said it intends to vigorously defend the lawsuit.
UCAR said the complaint against it and The Carbide/Graphite Group Ind and SGL Carbon Corp alleges the companies conspired to fix prices of graphite electrodes in violation of antitrust laws.
It said that, as far as it is aware, the suit is based on a previously-announced government investigation and the government has not alleged that any person or company vioated the law.
UCAR said it is the world's largest maker of graphite and carbon electrodes, which it sells primarily to steel producers.
